summary: Full backend + frontend test of Mihirkumar Ranva portfolio: duplicate-image removal, collection assignment, species names, lightbox story caption (gallery + series), admin edit-photo dialog, admin new-series create, per-photo PUT auth. All 12 pytest cases passed and all UI flows verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: SEED_PHOTOS re-writes p['order'] twice (loop at 425 then again at 428 without ordering). Harmless but dead code — the second loop should be removed.

server.py update_photo uses PhotoCreate model which forces title/image_url as required for every PUT; the frontend Admin sends full object so it works, but a PATCH-style model would be safer for future partial updates.
Admin.jsx PhotosTab.load() and SiteTab both refetch getPhotos independently — consider lifting shared photo state to avoid double network calls.

Instagram value in site.instagram is used by Footer (verify) but the Admin only exposes site-instagram field; ensure a runtime empty-string fallback is rendered as 'hidden' on the site (not tested here explicitly, only that field exists in admin).
test_credentials: Admin password: mihir2026 (from /app/backend/.env). Bearer token equals the password.
seed_data_creation: Test-only writes were made and reverted: (a) one photo's collection/story on 'The Leopard's Gaze' was set to TEST_* and restored to defaults; (b) a TEST_UITestSeries was added to site.collections and removed. Final site.collections keys are the original 5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_portfolio_api.py covers: photo count=16, no duplicate public_ids/urls, every photo has a collection, per-collection counts (Big Cats of Gir=3, Raptors & Owls=5, Wetlands of Junagadh=3, Songbirds of Gujarat=3, After Dark=2), expected species titles, story field non-empty, GET /api/site collections/currency/print_options/contact_email, unauthorized PUT /api/photos rejected, admin login, PUT /api/photos/{id} persists collection+story, PUT /api/site persists new/removed collections. Frontend verified via Playwright: 16 unique gallery images, gallery-lb-story & series-lb-story render, no cover-in-thumbs duplicates within a series block, admin edit-photo-<id> dialog updates collection (verified via API), new-series-name + add-series-btn + series-save-btn persists to site.collections.
